"""Compile validated data to a restricted FFmpeg graph; never accept arbitrary filters."""
import json
import html
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path


def stamp(ms):
    h, r = divmod(ms, 3600000)
    m, r = divmod(r, 60000)
    s, r = divmod(r, 1000)
    return f'{h:02}:{m:02}:{s:02},{r:03}'


def execute(argv, run_dir, label, timeout):
    folder = Path(run_dir) / 'commands'
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    ident = f'{time.time_ns()}_{label}'
    (folder / f'{ident}.argv.json').write_text(json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=run_dir, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
        (folder / f'{ident}.stdout.log').write_text(p.stdout, encoding='utf-8')
        (folder / f'{ident}.stderr.log').write_text(p.stderr, encoding='utf-8')
        (folder / f'{ident}.result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code': p.returncode}), encoding='utf-8')
        if p.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(f'{label} exit {p.returncode}: {p.stderr[-5000:]} (commands/{ident}.stderr.log)')
        return p.stdout
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
        (folder / f'{ident}.timeout.log').write_text(str(e), encoding='utf-8')
        raise


def render(t, report, inventory, config, run_dir):
    root = Path(inventory['asset_root'])
    assets = {a['asset_id']: a for a in inventory['assets']}
    run_dir = Path(run_dir).resolve()
    length = report['computed_duration_ms']
    srt = run_dir / f'captions_v{t.version}.srt'
    srt.write_text(''.join(f'{i}\n{stamp(c.start_ms)} --> {stamp(c.end_ms)}\n{html.escape(c.text.replace(chr(13), " ").replace(chr(10), " ").replace('-->', '→'), quote=False)}\n\n' for i, c in enumerate(t.captions, 1)), encoding='utf-8')
    argv = [config.ffmpeg, '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-filter_complex_threads', '1', '-y']
    input_indices = []
    n = 0
    for c in t.clips:
        a = assets[c.asset_id]
        seconds = (c.out_ms - c.in_ms if c.kind == 'video' else c.duration_ms) / 1000
        if c.kind == 'image':
            argv += ['-loop', '1', '-framerate', str(t.output.fps), '-t', str(seconds), '-i', str(root / a['relative_path'])]
        else:
            argv += ['-i', str(root / a['relative_path'])]
        video_idx = n
        n += 1
        if not a['has_audio'] or c.kind == 'image':
            argv += ['-f', 'lavfi', '-t', str(seconds), '-i', 'anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo']
            audio_idx = n
            n += 1
        else:
            audio_idx = video_idx
        input_indices.append((video_idx, audio_idx))
    bgm_idx = None
    if t.bgm:
        a = assets[t.bgm.asset_id]
        bgm_idx = n
        if t.bgm.loop:
            argv += ['-stream_loop', '-1']
        argv += ['-i', str(root / a['relative_path'])]
    graph = []
    w, h, fps = t.output.width, t.output.height, t.output.fps
    for i, (c, (vi, ai)) in enumerate(zip(t.clips, input_indices)):
        dur = (c.out_ms - c.in_ms if c.kind == 'video' else c.duration_ms) / 1000
        segment = f'trim=start={c.in_ms / 1000}:duration={dur}' if c.kind == 'video' else f'trim=duration={dur}'
        size = f'scale=w={w}:h={h}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad={w}:{h}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2' if c.fit == 'pad' else f'scale=w={w}:h={h}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={w}:{h}'
        vf = f'[{vi}:v]{segment},setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,{size},setsar=1,fps={fps},format=yuv420p,settb=AVTB'
        if c.transition_out.type == 'fade':
            vf += f',fade=t=out:st={dur-c.transition_out.duration_ms/1000}:d={c.transition_out.duration_ms/1000}'
        graph.append(vf + f'[v{i}]')
        trim = f'atrim=start={c.in_ms/1000}:duration={dur}' if c.kind == 'video' and ai == vi else f'atrim=duration={dur}'
        af = f'[{ai}:a]{trim},asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,aresample=48000,aformat=sample_fmts=fltp:channel_layouts=stereo,volume={"0" if c.mute else str(c.gain_db) + "dB"}'
        if c.transition_out.type == 'fade':
            af += f',afade=t=out:st={dur-c.transition_out.duration_ms/1000}:d={c.transition_out.duration_ms/1000}'
        graph.append(af + f'[a{i}]')
    vv, aa = 'v0', 'a0'
    for i in range(1, len(t.clips)):
        tr = t.clips[i-1].transition_out
        nextv, nexta = f'vc{i}', f'ac{i}'
        if tr.type == 'dissolve':
            offset = (report['clip_positions'][i]['start_ms']) / 1000
            graph.append(f'[{vv}][v{i}]xfade=transition=fade:duration={tr.duration_ms/1000}:offset={offset}[{nextv}]')
            graph.append(f'[{aa}][a{i}]acrossfade=d={tr.duration_ms/1000}:c1=tri:c2=tri[{nexta}]')
        else:
            graph.append(f'[{vv}][v{i}]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[{nextv}]')
            graph.append(f'[{aa}][a{i}]concat=n=2:v=0:a=1[{nexta}]')
        vv, aa = nextv, nexta
    if t.bgm:
        bgm = t.bgm
        remaining = (length - bgm.start_ms) / 1000
        graph.append(f'[{bgm_idx}:a]atrim=start={bgm.in_ms/1000}:duration={remaining},asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,aresample=48000,aformat=sample_fmts=fltp:channel_layouts=stereo,volume={bgm.gain_db}dB,afade=t=in:st=0:d={bgm.fade_in_ms/1000},afade=t=out:st={(length-bgm.start_ms-bgm.fade_out_ms)/1000}:d={bgm.fade_out_ms/1000},adelay={bgm.start_ms}|{bgm.start_ms}[music]')
        graph.append(f'[{aa}][music]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:normalize=0,atrim=duration={length/1000}[mixed]')
        aa = 'mixed'
    # cwd relative SRT avoids Windows drive-letter colon escaping in filter expressions.
    graph.append(f"[{vv}]subtitles=filename='{srt.name}':force_style='FontName=Microsoft YaHei,FontSize=40,Alignment=2,MarginV=52'[finalv]")
    pending = run_dir / f'output_v{t.version}.pending.mp4'
    argv += ['-filter_complex', ';'.join(graph), '-map', '[finalv]', '-map', f'[{aa}]', '-t', str(length/1000), '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'veryfast', '-crf', '24', '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p', '-r', str(fps), '-c:a', 'aac', '-ar', '48000', '-ac', '2', '-b:a', '128k', '-movflags', '+faststart', str(pending)]
    execute(argv, run_dir, f'render_v{t.version}', config.command_timeout_s)
    return str(pending)

"""Probe, fully decode, and visually inspect the actual pending encoded movie."""
import base64
import json
from pathlib import Path
from media import probe
from renderer import execute


def verify(pending, t, derived, inventory, requirements, config, run_dir, model):
    movie = Path(pending)
    if not movie.is_file() or movie.stat().st_size <= 10000:
        raise ValueError('Movie is missing or empty')
    info = probe(movie, config)
    video = next((s for s in info['streams'] if s['codec_type'] == 'video'), None)
    audio = next((s for s in info['streams'] if s['codec_type'] == 'audio'), None)
    duration = derived['computed_duration_ms']
    actual_ms = round(float(video.get('duration', info['format']['duration'])) * 1000) if video else None
    fps = video.get('avg_frame_rate', '0/0') if video else '0/0'
    numer, denom = map(int, fps.split('/'))
    actual_fps = numer / denom if denom else 0
    checks = []
    def check(name, condition, actual, req=None, evidence=None):
        checks.append({'check_id': name, 'requirement_id': req, 'status': 'pass' if condition else 'fail', 'actual': actual, 'evidence': evidence or str(movie)})
    check('nonempty', movie.stat().st_size > 10000, movie.stat().st_size)
    check('video_stream', bool(video) and video['width'] == t.output.width and video['height'] == t.output.height and video['codec_name'] == 'h264' and abs(actual_fps-t.output.fps) < .01,
          {'video': video, 'fps': actual_fps})
    check('video_duration_ms', actual_ms is not None and abs(actual_ms-duration) <= max(100, 2000/t.output.fps), {'video_ms': actual_ms, 'container_ms': round(float(info['format']['duration'])*1000), 'expected_ms': duration})
    check('audio_stream', bool(audio) and audio['codec_name'] == 'aac', audio)
    execute([config.ffmpeg, '-hide_banner', '-v', 'error', '-i', str(movie), '-f', 'null', '-'], run_dir, f'decode_v{t.version}', config.command_timeout_s)
    check('full_decode', True, 'ffmpeg returned exit 0', evidence='commands/*decode*.result.json')
    points = {0, max(0, duration-100), 1000, max(0, duration-1000)}
    for pos in derived['clip_positions']:
        points.add((pos['start_ms'] + pos['end_ms']) // 2)
        points.add(max(0, pos['end_ms']-150))
        points.add(min(duration-100, pos['end_ms']+150))
    folder = Path(run_dir) / 'verification_frames'
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    frames = []
    for ms in sorted(p for p in points if 0 <= p < duration):
        frame = folder / f'v{t.version}_{ms}.jpg'
        execute([config.ffmpeg, '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-y', '-ss', f'{ms/1000:.3f}', '-i', str(movie), '-frames:v', '1', '-q:v', '3', str(frame)], run_dir, f'frame_v{t.version}_{ms}', config.command_timeout_s)
        frames.append({'time_ms': ms, 'path': str(frame)})
    title = next(c.text for c in t.captions if c.start_ms == 0)
    ending = next(c.text for c in t.captions if c.end_ms == duration)
    first = t.clips[0].kind
    content = [{'type': 'input_text', 'text': f'Inspect ONLY these frames sampled from the ACTUAL encoded movie. Title at 1000ms should visually read exactly {title!r}; ending at 9000ms should read exactly {ending!r}. First clip type is {first} (static image has DEMO_STILL; video has dynamic DEMO_01/02/03). Inspect first/last order. Return only JSON with booleans title_visible, ending_visible, order_visible and uncertainty; do not claim unobserved frames verified.'}]
    for ms in (1000, 9000, 100):
        frame = min(frames, key=lambda x: abs(x['time_ms']-ms))
        content += [{'type': 'input_text', 'text': f"Movie timestamp {frame['time_ms']}ms evidence {frame['path']}"}, {'type': 'input_image', 'image_url': 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + base64.b64encode(Path(frame['path']).read_bytes()).decode()}]
    result = model.respond([{'role': 'user', 'content': content}], purpose='encoded_movie_visual_review').output_text
    try:
        observed = json.loads(result.strip().removeprefix('```json').removesuffix('```').strip())
    except ValueError:
        observed = {'uncertainty': result}
    for key in ('title_visible', 'ending_visible', 'order_visible'):
        check('visual_'+key, observed.get(key) is True, observed, evidence=frames)
    for req in requirements['hard_constraints']:
        field = req['field']
        associated = ['video_stream', 'video_duration_ms', 'audio_stream', 'full_decode']
        if field.startswith('title_'):
            associated += ['visual_title_visible']
        if field.startswith('ending_'):
            associated += ['visual_ending_visible']
        if field == 'clip_order':
            associated += ['visual_order_visible']
        if field in ('bgm_gain_db', 'video_gain_db', 'video_mute', 'bgm_fade_in_ms', 'bgm_fade_out_ms'):
            evidence = {'validated_timeline': f'timeline_v{t.version}.json', 'controlled_source_graph': 'commands/*render*.argv.json', 'decoded_audio': bool(audio)}
        else:
            evidence = {'timeline_semantic_check': next(c for c in derived['constraint_checks'] if c['requirement_id'] == req['requirement_id']), 'movie_frames': frames if field in ('clip_order', 'title_text', 'ending_text') else []}
        check('hard_'+req['requirement_id'], all(next(c for c in checks if c['check_id'] == n)['status'] == 'pass' for n in associated), {'field': field, 'expected': req['expected']}, req['requirement_id'], evidence)
    return {'version': t.version, 'status': 'pass' if all(c['status'] == 'pass' for c in checks) else 'needs_review', 'checks': checks, 'probe': {'video_duration_ms': actual_ms, 'container_duration_ms': round(float(info['format']['duration'])*1000)}, 'visual_review_raw': result, 'sampled_frames': frames, 'limitations': ['Sampled visual frames do not establish every intermediate frame', 'Gain is verified by controlled source graph and encoded audio presence, not isolated-source waveform separation']}

"""Strict editable timeline schema and source/constraint semantic checks."""
from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, StrictInt, field_validator


class Strict(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')


class Output(Strict):
    width: StrictInt = Field(gt=0)
    height: StrictInt = Field(gt=0)
    fps: StrictInt = Field(gt=0)
    container: Literal['mp4']
    video_codec: Literal['libx264']
    audio_codec: Literal['aac']


class Transition(Strict):
    type: Literal['cut', 'fade', 'dissolve']
    duration_ms: StrictInt = Field(ge=0)


class Clip(Strict):
    clip_id: str
    asset_id: str
    kind: Literal['video', 'image']
    in_ms: StrictInt | None
    out_ms: StrictInt | None
    duration_ms: StrictInt | None
    fit: Literal['pad', 'crop']
    mute: bool
    gain_db: float
    transition_out: Transition


class Caption(Strict):
    caption_id: str
    start_ms: StrictInt = Field(ge=0)
    end_ms: StrictInt = Field(ge=0)
    text: str
    style_id: Literal['default_zh']


class BGM(Strict):
    asset_id: str
    in_ms: StrictInt = Field(ge=0)
    start_ms: StrictInt = Field(ge=0)
    gain_db: float
    loop: bool
    fade_in_ms: StrictInt = Field(ge=0)
    fade_out_ms: StrictInt = Field(ge=0)


class Timeline(Strict):
    schema_version: Literal['1.0']
    version: StrictInt = Field(gt=0)
    parent_version: StrictInt | None
    request_ids: list[str]
    asset_manifest_hash: str
    constraint_set_id: str
    output: Output
    clips: list[Clip]
    captions: list[Caption]
    bgm: BGM | None


def check(data, inventory, requirements):
    t = Timeline.model_validate(data)
    assets = {a['asset_id']: a for a in inventory['assets']}
    if t.asset_manifest_hash != inventory['manifest_hash'] or t.constraint_set_id != requirements['constraint_set_id']:
        raise ValueError('Asset/constraint hash mismatch')
    if t.version != requirements['version'] or t.parent_version != (t.version - 1 if t.version > 1 else None):
        raise ValueError('Incorrect revision lineage')
    if t.request_ids != requirements['request_ids']:
        raise ValueError('Request lineage mismatch')
    if not t.clips or len({c.clip_id for c in t.clips}) != len(t.clips) or len({c.caption_id for c in t.captions}) != len(t.captions):
        raise ValueError('Missing clips or duplicate IDs')
    positions, elapsed, prev_overlap = [], 0, 0
    for i, c in enumerate(t.clips):
        a = assets.get(c.asset_id)
        if a is None or a['kind'] != c.kind:
            raise ValueError(f'{c.clip_id}: invalid video/image asset')
        if c.kind == 'video':
            if c.in_ms is None or c.out_ms is None or c.duration_ms is not None or c.in_ms < 0 or c.out_ms <= c.in_ms or c.out_ms > a['duration_ms']:
                raise ValueError(f'{c.clip_id}: video source interval invalid')
            length = c.out_ms - c.in_ms
        else:
            if c.in_ms is not None or c.out_ms is not None or c.duration_ms is None or c.duration_ms <= 0:
                raise ValueError(f'{c.clip_id}: image duration/source invalid')
            length = c.duration_ms
        tr = c.transition_out
        if (tr.type == 'cut' and tr.duration_ms != 0) or (tr.type != 'cut' and (tr.duration_ms <= 0 or tr.duration_ms >= length)):
            raise ValueError(f'{c.clip_id}: transition duration invalid')
        if i == len(t.clips) - 1 and tr.type == 'dissolve':
            raise ValueError('Last clip cannot dissolve')
        if prev_overlap + (tr.duration_ms if tr.type == 'dissolve' else 0) > length:
            raise ValueError('Neighboring dissolve overlaps exceed clip length')
        start = elapsed - prev_overlap
        positions.append({'clip_id': c.clip_id, 'start_ms': start, 'end_ms': start + length})
        elapsed = start + length
        prev_overlap = tr.duration_ms if tr.type == 'dissolve' else 0
    for c in t.captions:
        if not c.text or c.end_ms <= c.start_ms or c.end_ms > elapsed:
            raise ValueError(f'{c.caption_id}: caption outside movie')
    if t.bgm:
        a = assets.get(t.bgm.asset_id)
        if not a or a['kind'] != 'audio' or t.bgm.start_ms >= elapsed or t.bgm.in_ms >= a['duration_ms'] or (not t.bgm.loop and elapsed - t.bgm.start_ms > a['duration_ms'] - t.bgm.in_ms) or t.bgm.fade_in_ms + t.bgm.fade_out_ms > elapsed - t.bgm.start_ms:
            raise ValueError('BGM source/range/fades invalid')
    actual = {'duration_ms': elapsed, 'width': t.output.width, 'height': t.output.height, 'fps': t.output.fps, 'container': t.output.container, 'video_codec': t.output.video_codec, 'audio_codec': t.output.audio_codec,
              'clip_order': [c.kind for c in t.clips], 'title_text': next((c.text for c in t.captions if c.start_ms == 0), None), 'title_start_ms': 0, 'title_end_ms': next((c.end_ms for c in t.captions if c.start_ms == 0), None),
              'ending_text': next((c.text for c in t.captions if c.end_ms == elapsed), None), 'ending_start_ms': next((c.start_ms for c in t.captions if c.end_ms == elapsed), None), 'ending_end_ms': elapsed,
              'transition_type': t.clips[0].transition_out.type, 'transition_ms': t.clips[0].transition_out.duration_ms,
              'video_gain_db': [c.gain_db for c in t.clips if c.kind == 'video'], 'video_mute': [c.mute for c in t.clips if c.kind == 'video'],
              'bgm_gain_db': t.bgm.gain_db if t.bgm else None, 'bgm_fade_in_ms': t.bgm.fade_in_ms if t.bgm else None, 'bgm_fade_out_ms': t.bgm.fade_out_ms if t.bgm else None,
              'fit': [c.fit for c in t.clips]}
    failures = []
    for req in requirements['hard_constraints']:
        key, expected = req['field'], req['expected']
        got = actual.get(key)
        if key == 'transition_type' and expected == 'cross_dissolve':
            # Requirements retain the natural-language semantic label; the wire schema calls this dissolve.
            good = got == 'dissolve'
        elif key in ('video_gain_db', 'video_mute', 'fit'):
            good = bool(got) and all(x == expected for x in got)
        elif key == 'clip_order':
            good = got == expected
        else:
            good = got == expected
        if not good:
            failures.append({'requirement_id': req['requirement_id'], 'field': key, 'expected': expected, 'actual': got})
    if failures:
        raise ValueError(f'Hard constraint violations: {failures}')
    return t, {'computed_duration_ms': elapsed, 'clip_positions': positions, 'constraint_checks': [{'requirement_id': x['requirement_id'], 'field': x['field'], 'actual': actual[x['field']], 'status': 'pass'} for x in requirements['hard_constraints']]}

# Coding Agent 与视频剪辑 Agent

按任务书分阶段实现的 Python CLI 项目。通用 Coding Agent 使用真实模型工具循环编写和运行代码；视频业务由该 Agent 在阶段 A 验收后生成。用户已授权使用自制 10 秒演示素材，开发总预算按最新要求调整为两小时。

## 环境

已验证 Windows、Python 3.13.7、Git、FFmpeg/ffprobe 8.1.2、openai 2.44.0、pydantic 2.13.4。兼容 Python 3.12+。FFmpeg 需要 libx264、AAC、subtitles/ASS、xfade，并安装可用中文字体。

```powershell
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
$env:OPENAI_API_KEY = "你的密钥"
python scripts/preflight.py --check-model --output reports/env_check.json
python scripts/make_demo_assets.py --output materials/demo
```

配置见 config.example.json。模型固定 `gpt-6-sol`、推理等级固定 `high`，不自动切换模型。密钥仅从环境变量读取。可通过 `OPENAI_BASE_URL` 或 `api_base` 指定兼容端点；接口必须支持 Responses、图片和函数工具。未知单价记为 null，不能解释为免费。

## 通用 Coding Agent

```powershell
python coding_agent.py run --task examples/coding_smoke.txt --workspace .local/smoke_workspace --run-dir runs/stage_a --config config.example.json --acceptance reports/coding_smoke_acceptance.json --read-only test_calculator.py --allow-write calculator.py --allow-write sum_cli.py
```

上述命令使用阶段 A 现场建立的独立工作目录；其中真实的初始失败、源码修改和成功执行保存在 runs/stage_a。通用任务可换用自己的目录、任务文本及验收 JSON；验收格式为 `{"commands":[["python","test_example.py"]]}`。只有独立验收通过的 finish 才视为完成。`--resume` 从指定 run-dir 检查点恢复；可用 `--max-turns` 和 `--total-timeout-s` 限定预算。

工具包括 list_files、read_file、write_file、replace_text、run_process、finish。进程使用 argv 与超时；文件变更记录 SHA256 和 diff。路径限制减少误操作，不是任意程序的安全沙箱。子代理禁止删除文件，不允许改写验收以求通过。阶段完成后由执行者提交并推送 Git。

## 阶段证据

- 实施范围与验收：docs/requirements.md。
- 环境检查与计时范围：reports/。
- 编程失败、修复、验收、模型用量：runs/stage_a/。
- 合成素材生成命令与哈希：materials/demo/manifest.json。

## 视频 Agent（已实际运行）

```powershell
python video_agent.py create --assets materials/demo --request examples/request_v1.txt --run-dir runs/demo --config config.example.json
python video_agent.py revise --run-dir runs/demo --base-revision 1 --request examples/request_v2.txt --config config.example.json
python scripts/accept_video.py
```

`--config` 缺省为 `config.example.json`。FFmpeg/ffprobe 和中文字体必须可用，模型图片与工具调用需要配置支持 Responses API 的凭据。模型分析的是抽样素材帧和**实际编码成片**帧，不把未采样时段描述为已确认；演示为无对白合成素材，文案来自用户，不启动 ASR。若正式任务需要对白识别/自动字幕且没有带时间戳的真实 ASR 服务，将明确失败，不会编造转录。模型提取需求后冻结 `requirements_vN.json`；v2 继承除明确替代的标题和镜头顺序外的每项硬要求。视频镜头时长是源区间，图片显示时长独立；500ms dissolve 是真实交叠并含跨淡音频。中文 SRT 由本地文件烧录。Pydantic 和实际源文件共同约束时间线；渲染只允许经本地编译的滤镜，产物先验证 `.pending.mp4` 再原子发布。若通过版本已存在，重复运行不会覆盖。

交付在 `runs/demo/`：`assets.json`、`analysis.json`、`requirements_v1/v2.json`、`timeline_v1/v2.json`、`derived_v1/v2.json`、`output_v1/v2.mp4`、`validation_v1/v2.json`、`revision_diff.json`、`events.jsonl`、`usage.json`、`manifest.json`、两版 `agent_v*/checkpoint.json`、证据帧与 `commands/` 原始 argv/退出码/标准输出错误。失败候选和故障文件一并保留，禁止删除；`manifest.json` 不递归哈希自身，关联素材 SHA256。费用缺乏核实单价时为 null/unknown。

若正常渲染没有自然失败，独立的**显式故障注入**用于真实证明错误→修复：

```powershell
python video_agent.py fault-demo --run-dir runs/demo --config config.example.json
```

此命令用刻意无效的视频编码器触发 FFmpeg 非零退出，记录原始 stderr 和故障来源，再用 `libx264` 修正并 probe 真正生成的诊断媒体；诊断产物**不**替代两版正式成片。每版渲染最多首次加两次修复尝试。验证含完整解码、流参数、时长和模型复核的有限采样帧；不能保证未采样每帧内容，也不能凭混合音轨完全隔离证明单一路的增益，增益以受控滤镜链、源证据和真实 AAC 音轨为依据。指定服务、计费和评分细则等未确认事项仍需正式考核方确认。媒体文件保存在本地，由主执行者处理 Git 提交。

"""Immutable, small end-to-end acceptance gate for the authorized demo."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RUN = ROOT / "runs" / "demo"


def read(name):
    return json.loads((RUN / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def main():
    required_sources = ["video_agent.py", "media.py", "timeline.py", "renderer.py", "verify.py"]
    for name in required_sources:
        source = ROOT / name
        assert source.is_file(), f"Missing source: {name}"
        compile(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), name, "exec")
    for name in ["assets.json", "analysis.json", "requirements_v1.json", "requirements_v2.json", "revision_diff.json", "manifest.json", "usage.json", "events.jsonl"]:
        assert (RUN / name).is_file(), f"Missing delivery evidence: {name}"
    assets = read("assets.json")
    rows = assets["assets"] if isinstance(assets, dict) else assets
    kinds = {x["asset_id"]: x["kind"] for x in rows}
    assert {"video", "image", "audio"} <= set(kinds.values()), "Probe all three media kinds"
    for version, title, first in [(1, "十秒灵感", "video"), (2, "让灵感再快一步", "image")]:
        t = read(f"timeline_v{version}.json")
        assert t["version"] == version
        assert t["parent_version"] == (None if version == 1 else 1)
        assert t["output"]["width"] == 1280 and t["output"]["height"] == 720
        assert t["output"]["fps"] == 30
        clips = t["clips"]
        assert len(clips) >= 2 and kinds[clips[0]["asset_id"]] == first, "Required clip order"
        assert any(c["transition_out"]["type"] == "dissolve" and c["transition_out"]["duration_ms"] == 500 for c in clips[:-1])
        duration = sum(c["out_ms"]-c["in_ms"] if c["kind"] == "video" else c["duration_ms"] for c in clips)
        duration -= sum(c["transition_out"]["duration_ms"] for c in clips[:-1] if c["transition_out"]["type"] == "dissolve")
        assert duration == 10000, f"Timeline duration {duration} != 10000"
        assert any(c["text"] == title and c["start_ms"] == 0 and c["end_ms"] == 3000 for c in t["captions"])
        assert any(c["text"] == "由视频 Agent 自动剪辑" and c["start_ms"] == 8000 and c["end_ms"] == 10000 for c in t["captions"])
        assert t["bgm"] and t["bgm"]["gain_db"] == -20
        for c in clips:
            assert c["fit"] == "pad"
            if c["kind"] == "video":
                assert c["gain_db"] == -18 and not c["mute"]
        report = read(f"validation_v{version}.json")
        assert report["status"] == "pass", f"Version {version}: {report.get('status')}"
        movie = RUN / f"output_v{version}.mp4"
        assert movie.is_file() and movie.stat().st_size > 10000
        p = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_streams", "-show_format", "-of", "json", str(movie)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
        probe = json.loads(p.stdout)
        v = next(s for s in probe["streams"] if s["codec_type"] == "video")
        a = next(s for s in probe["streams"] if s["codec_type"] == "audio")
        assert v["width"] == 1280 and v["height"] == 720 and v["codec_name"] == "h264"
        assert a["codec_name"] == "aac"
        assert abs(float(v.get("duration", probe["format"]["duration"])) - 10) <= 0.1
    assert hashlib.sha256((RUN / "output_v1.mp4").read_bytes()).hexdigest() != hashlib.sha256((RUN / "output_v2.mp4").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    print("VIDEO_DEMO_ACCEPTED: two independently checked 10s revisions")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"VIDEO_DEMO_REJECTED: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
